# typeset.us

> Typeset 4.2.0: measured composition for titles, prose and ordinary rich text.
> Unicode breaks, bounded word spacing and per-line tracking, clipped hanging,
> incremental scheduling, markup-preserving rendering and post-render verification.

Install: npm install typeset.us@4.2.0. For static HTML, use
<script src="https://typeset.us/go@4.2.0.js" defer></script> and override
data-typeset-selector to choose text. For React-owned content use
TypesetText or TypesetRichText from typeset.us/react, never overlapping mounts.
auditJSON reports errors, reviews, coverage, native retention and feature
outcomes. A passing safety audit is not a claim of perfect aesthetics.
Declared languages: en/fr/de/es; untagged Latin has neutral preferences.

## Docs

- [For agents](https://typeset.us/for-agents): canonical install, scoping,
  and verification instructions for AI coding agents
- [Library](https://typeset.us/library): the engine's rules, constants, and
  the measurements behind them

## Package

- [typeset.us on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/typeset.us):
  typeset.us@4.2.0, MIT: ESM, CJS, browser global, React and declarations
- [Capabilities](https://typeset.us/capabilities.json): machine-readable support contract
- [Migration](https://typeset.us/releases/4.2.0/MIGRATION.md): ownership, options and rollback
- [Support](https://typeset.us/releases/4.2.0/SUPPORT.md): tested range and outstanding acceptance
- [Integrity](https://typeset.us/sri.json): immutable browser pins
- [V3 archive](https://typeset.us/releases/3.5.1/): old source, npm and browser assets
